summary_en: ¥30.0B buyback upper limit, 6,910,000 shares (10.55% of shares outstanding), ToSTNeT-3 method, execution window 24–26 August 2026. Rationale: strengthen shareholder returns and capital efficiency per capital-cost policy; offset share demand from concurrent equity offering.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of treasury stock pursuant to Articles of Incorporation under Company Law Article 459(1))
translation_en_brief: LINTEC Corporation announced on 20 August 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire its own shares under the Articles of Incorporation (Company Law Article 459(1)). The company will acquire up to 6,910,000 shares (10.55% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum ¥30.0 billion using the ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours) method during the window 24–26 August 2026. The price ceiling per share is not specified in the disclosure. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency consistent with the company's March 2024 capital-cost policy (which targets a dividend payout ratio of 40% or more, or DOE of 3%, and authorizes opportunistic share buybacks through FY3/27). Additionally, the buyback is intended to offset share-supply dynamics from a concurrent equity offering of ordinary shares announced the same day. Execution authority is delegated to the representative director and president. The company notes that market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the buyback.
